dogecoin.text: @jfnewbery So what? You just don't get it. Anyone who bought #Dogecoin at the end of 2020 has a far greater return than anyone who bought #Bitcoin. I remember Bitcoin bulls dismissed that very argument when Bitcoin's market cap was compared to #gold's. Have fun staying poor!

@SpencerKSchiff #Bitcoin is yesterday. #Dogecoin is tomorrow. Dogecoin is better at being Bitcoin than Bitcoin. You're just too old to understand the new technology behind Dogecoin. Ask your younger brother Preston to explain it to you. He's 7 and he gets it.

Dogecoin may have been created as a joke, but all cryptos are jokes. The problem is that the Kool-Aid drinkers don't get it yet. The irony is that #Dogecoin may end up being the punchline to the joke known as #Bitcoin. But instead of laughing Bitcoin HODLers will be left crying.
@SpencerKSchiff I've got a better idea.  Let's all put laser beams on our noses until #Dogecoin hits $1.

While @elonmusk was tweeting about #Bitcoin he was also taking advantage of the rally his tweets helped created by dumping 10% of @Tesla's stash. He may have bought Bitcoin, but he's not HODLing it. My guess is that he's not done selling. I wonder what he's doing with #Dogecoin?
